metadata.title: Procedural tool for analysing building energy performance: structural equation modelling protocol

eligibility.methodological_eligibility.quote: The Performance Metrics (PMs) are subset objectives used for measuring the energy performance of each case study building while the Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) are standardised whole-building analysis metrics used for comparing and benchmarking across case-study buildings
eligibility.methodological_eligibility.rule: §5.2: propoe e avalia um modelo de medicao de desempenho energetico com variaveis, forma funcional e abordagem de estimacao identificaveis; edificios nao-residenciais nao sao exclusao topical.
